theorems.name: Submission.gwe_wewe_setIntegral_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (S : Set X) (g D : X → ℝ), μ S < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μ.restrict S) → IntegrableOn D S μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict S), 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ^ 2 ≤ D x) → ∫ x in S, g x ∂μ ≤ Real.sqrt (μ S).toReal * Real.sqrt (∫ x in S, D x ∂μ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
